title: March 12 Mega Millions
heading: March 12 Mega Millions Madness
description: The upcoming Mega Millions jackpot on Tuesday, March 12th is set to reach $735,000,000 and climbs to six on the top 10 jackpots of all time
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Tuesday, March 12 marks another chapter in the saga of American Mega Millions history, and you don’t want to miss out on the action! All eyes are on the staggering jackpot soaring to rarely seen heights.

The upcoming Mega Millions jackpot on Tuesday, March 12th has reached an astounding $735,000,000.

This jackpot has climbed up the list to number 6 on the all-time top 10 Mega Millions jackpots in history:

  • $1.602 billion, Aug. 8, 2023 won in Florida
  • $1.537 billion, Oct. 23, 2018 won in South Carolina
  • $1.348 billion, Jan. 13, 2023 won in Maine
  • $1.337 billion: July 29, 2022 won in Illinois
  • $1.05 billion, Jan. 22, 2021 won in Michigan
  • $735 million, March 12, 2024: (Current jackpot in play!)
  • $656 million, March 30, 2012 shared in Illinois, Kansas, Maryland
  • $648 million, Dec. 17, 2013 shared in California, Georgia
  • $543 million, July 24, 2018 won in California
  • $536 million, July 8, 20116 won in Indiana

Will this week’s mammoth jackpot make its mark as the sixth largest of all time? Why not play for a jackpot that is rewriting the record books!

March 12th is your moment to seize the opportunity as history passes by. The only way to join the ranks of Mega Millions winners is to have a ticket in play.

Fortune favors the bold. Good luck!
